name: 5L-bench
description: 5L-bench is a newly curated benchmark for evaluating lifelong learning capabilities of large language models using question-answer pairs. It provides a dataset and evaluation metrics for assessing performance in both open-book and closed-book settings, focusing on knowledge retention and robustness to catastrophic forgetting.
reputation: A very recent benchmark for lifelong learning in LLMs, with promising research interest but limited established community adoption so far.
notes: Introduces a new evaluation benchmark and metrics specifically for lifelong learning in LLMs.
